'''2004 Origins Justin Stratton DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Stratton]] at [[2004 Origins]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Justin "Nitsuj" Stratton (2004-09-20).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33730 Watto, Origins 2004]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041101032225/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33730/ Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Stratton]]
